title: A Simple Rental Contract
text:
A rental agreement is a legal contract between a landlord and a tenant. It states the monthly rent, the length of the lease, and the date when payment is due. Both parties must sign the document before the tenant moves in. If one side breaks the agreement, the other side may be able to take legal action.

The contract also describes the responsibilities of each party. For example, the tenant must keep the apartment clean and report repairs quickly. The landlord, in turn, must make sure that the building is safe and that the heating works. Any changes to the agreement must be written down and signed by both people.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what must both parties do before the tenant moves in?
options: Register the contract at a bank

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what must the tenant do?
options: Keep the apartment clean and report repairs quickly
Sign a new contract every month

questions.text: Why does the passage say that any change to the agreement must be signed by both people?
options: To make sure both sides accept the change and it is legally valid
To allow the landlord to keep the deposit
To remove the tenant's right to take legal action

questions.text: What is the most likely consequence if the tenant does not report repairs quickly?
options: The landlord will always pay for the repairs
The problem may get worse and the tenant may fail to meet the agreement
The tenant receives a lower monthly rent

vocabulary.definition: a contract that allows someone to use a property for a set period in exchange for rent
a person who pays rent to live in a property owned by someone else
duties that a person is expected to carry out
relating to the law or allowed by the law

paragraph_translations: Um contrato de locação é um acordo jurídico entre um locador e um inquilino. Ele estabelece o aluguel mensal, a duração do contrato e a data em que o pagamento vence. As duas partes devem assinar o documento antes que o inquilino se mude. Se um dos lados descumprir o acordo, o outro pode ter direito a tomar medidas legais.

O contrato também descreve as responsabilidades de cada parte. Por exemplo, o inquilino deve manter o apartamento limpo e comunicar os reparos rapidamente. O locador, por sua vez, deve garantir que o prédio seja seguro e que o aquecimento funcione. Qualquer alteração no acordo deve ser escrita e assinada por ambas as pessoas.
